items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: that's what Louis Hines did. So, I got the idea from him, of course I played a chord instrument just like he did.

ctx.x: What did Willie Foster teach you? How did he teach you the language?

He taught me the rhythms of it there, from the bottom of it. He taught me melody and chords, and I developed a style of my own, similar to Earl Hines. Well, like Earl Hines played piano. I adopted it like that. I got the idea, well I didn't get all of it, but I got a lot of him, but more of me. More of Al, you know what I mean? Well, he got the idea, he stole from Louis Armstrong, that's what Louis Hines did. So, I got the idea from him, of course I played a chord instrument just like he did. And then, as the…
What does he do? What did he get money for?
